races.name: Sedgefield Racecourse Supports Autism In Racing Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Captain Cool
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with solid recent form who should get an uncontested lead

runners_data.name: Diamond Jim
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner who prefers to race prominently and has excellent recent win

runners_data.name: Fine Point
runners_data.note: Consistent sort who stays well but needs to improve his tactical position

runners_data.name: Maple
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who has been running well at shorter trips recently

runners_data.name: Blackwater Lilly
runners_data.note: Needs a strong pace to be effective from her preferred hold-up position

runners_data.name: Ambassador
runners_data.note: Longest-priced runner who stays well but has been disappointing lately

runners_data.name: Belaya River
runners_data.note: Strong recent soft ground form may not fully translate to today's better surface

races.paceDynamic: Captain Cool will take them along from the front with no serious pace pressure, allowing him to dictate terms at a sustainable gallop. Diamond Jim and Fine Point are likely to track close behind, but neither is aggressive enough to hassle the leader early, setting up a tactical finish where the hold-up horses Maple, Blackwater Lilly, and Belaya River must rely on their closing kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool gets an easy lead and maintains his jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the closers to make up ground, and Captain Cool's recent good form on similar going pays dividends. His 5 places from 8 runs on good ground shows he handles these conditions consistently.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Kick Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and multiple horses arrive together at the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Maple and Belaya River to get into contention, with Maple's recent course form (2nd twice at shorter trips) proving crucial. Diamond Jim's class advantage shows in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool's jumping deteriorates or the pace quickens mid-race
scenarios.body: Blackwater Lilly and Belaya River benefit from a stronger gallop that stretches the field, with Belaya River's recent soft ground form translating well. The hold-up horses get the run of the race they need.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If Fine Point or Ambassador improve their tactical position early
scenarios.body: Fine Point uses his consistent recent form (4 places from last 5) to track closer than usual, while Ambassador's longer trip experience helps. The middle-distance specialists outbattle the pure front-runner and closers.

watchPoints.text: Captain Cool's jumping - any mistakes will immediately bring Diamond Jim and Fine Point into contention
Maple's stamina at this longer trip after two recent runs over shorter distances
Fine Point's early positioning - he needs to be closer than usual to his recent races
Belaya River's adaptation from soft to good ground given his recent surface preference
Diamond Jim's tactical approach - whether he lets Captain Cool go or applies early pressure

races.name: Sign Lead Your Horse To Water Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Realisation
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong similar going record (8 runs, 1 win, 6 places) who needs others to go hard early

runners_data.name: Mountain Mike
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with highest official rating (117) but concerning heavy ground form in recent outings

runners_data.name: Stratagem
runners_data.note: Proven on softer ground with 2 wins from 15 similar going starts, suits prominent tactics

runners_data.name: Mary Stanford
runners_data.note: Front runner with limited similar going experience but tactical pace advantage from the lead

runners_data.name: Ailt An Chorrain
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader with decent similar going record (2 wins, 2 places from 10 starts) who stays well

races.paceDynamic: Ailt An Chorrain and Mary Stanford will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front runners likely to set a solid gallop from the outset. Mountain Mike and Stratagem will track the pace in prominent positions, leaving Realisation as the sole hold-up performer seeking cover early. The battle between the two leaders should create an honest tempo that will test stamina over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace Favours Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Ailt An Chorrain and Mary Stanford go too hard early and weaken
scenarios.body: The two leaders burn each other out with their early duel, allowing the hold-up Realisation to pick up the pieces late. Mountain Mike may also benefit from tracking the unsustainable pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Mary Stanford or Ailt An Chorrain establishes a clear lead without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The winner gets an uncontested lead and maintains it to the line with superior stamina reserves. The other front runner fades from trying to match the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prosper
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady early allowing trackers to travel comfortably
scenarios.body: Mountain Mike and Stratagem benefit from the perfect tracking position behind a controlled tempo. They can strike when the leaders weaken while Realisation has too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Sorts Field
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine throughout creating a true staying test
scenarios.body: The extended distance and honest gallop finds out any stamina limitations in the field. Only the most genuine stayers remain competitive in the final half-mile.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Mary Stanford and Ailt An Chorrain go too fast early - could set up the race for Realisation coming from behind
Monitor Mountain Mike's jumping under pressure given recent heavy ground struggles may affect confidence
Observe Stratagem's position turning for home as proven similar going performer could be value play
Check if Realisation gets the strong pace required for hold-up style to be effective over this trip
Note which front runner (Mary Stanford or Ailt An Chorrain) establishes clearer advantage in opening mile

runners_data.name: Restandbethankful

races.paceDynamic: Dixie Cowboy will set a steady, uncontested lead with Clean Getaway, Nonbinding, and Restandbethankful tracking within striking distance through the early stages. The lack of pace pressure should create a sustainable gallop that suits the hold-up horses Natural Ability, Beep Beep Becky, Myfavouritesister, and Elusive Warrior to mount late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Dixie Cowboy maintains an even tempo without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The front runners get an easy lead and kick clear approaching the last fence. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the established advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too steady allowing closers time to organize
scenarios.body: Natural Ability and Beep Beep Becky time their runs perfectly from the back. The leaders pay for their earlier efforts as fresh finishers sweep past.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Takes Over
scenarios.trigger: If Clean Getaway or Nonbinding apply pressure to Dixie Cowboy mid-race
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favors horses with tactical speed positioned just off the pace. These runners can respond to the acceleration while still having enough left for the finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Long Shot Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final half-mile creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Lower-rated horses like Myfavouritesister or Elusive Warrior benefit from the tactical nature of the race. Class differences become less relevant in a slowly-run tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Dixie Cowboy could get too easy a lead if no prominent runners apply early pressure
Natural Ability needs the pace to develop strongly to be effective from his hold-up position
Beep Beep Becky returning from long break and may need this run to reach full fitness
Nonbinding has question marks over recent form with multiple non-completions
Myfavouritesister drops significantly in class which could make her competitive at longer odds

runners_data.name: Phantom Gold

runners_data.name: Monark Wood
runners_data.note: Hold-up style needs luck in running from this small field

runners_data.name: Fearless Dragon
runners_data.note: Long absence concern despite solid earlier form on good ground

runners_data.name: Bright Legend
runners_data.note: Consistent placer who should get ideal tracking position behind leader

runners_data.name: Hay Max
runners_data.note: Strong recent form but needs to overcome hold-up style disadvantage

runners_data.name: Who's Glen
runners_data.note: Prolific placer whose closing style requires genuine pace to aim at

races.paceDynamic: Phantom Gold will lead uncontested from the start, setting a comfortable gallop that suits his front-running style perfectly. With Bright Legend the only other potential early pace influence but likely to settle prominently rather than challenge for the lead, Phantom Gold gets ideal conditions to dictate terms throughout the 2m4f journey.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Phantom Gold Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Phantom Gold jumps cleanly and maintains rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The leader faces no early pressure and kicks clear approaching the final flight with the field struggling to close the gap. His solid going record and front-running style prove decisive over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Catches Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady early allowing closers to strike
scenarios.body: Phantom Gold's lack of recent pressure running leaves him vulnerable when Hay Max and Who's Glen unleash late challenges up the hill. The hold-up horses find their rhythm perfectly timed for the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bright Legend Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If Bright Legend travels strongly in behind the leader throughout
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets first run on the weakening Phantom Gold and holds off the deeper closers who leave their move too late. His recent Sandown third over similar conditions gives him the edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the pressure or jumping errors occur
scenarios.body: Fearless Dragon or Monark Wood capitalize on mistakes from the favorites, with their fresher profiles proving advantageous. The race opens up dramatically in the final half-mile creating opportunities for unconsidered runners.

watchPoints.text: Phantom Gold's jumping under pressure - any mistake when challenged could prove fatal
Whether Bright Legend goes forward enough early to secure the crucial second position
How quickly Hay Max and Who's Glen can organize their challenges from the back
If the pace becomes crawling, favoring the hold-up horses significantly
Fearless Dragon's fitness levels after extended break since last meaningful run

races.paceDynamic: Achnamara is the clear pace angle with Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul likely to press from prominent positions early. With limited genuine pace pressure, Achnamara can dictate a steady gallop that will suit the large contingent of hold-up horses including Top Flight Century, Knacker Trapper, and the improving Laddie Cooper Mia who will all need the race to develop into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Cavalry Charge
scenarios.trigger: If Achnamara is allowed an uncontested lead and the pace stays modest throughout
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a furlong sprint finish where class and finishing kick matter most. Top Flight Century and Cosmic Soul emerge from the pack with late surges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul press Achnamara from the outset creating stronger early fractions
scenarios.body: The sustained pace stretches the field and exposes the stamina of the hold-up horses over this extended trip. Byron Hill's prominent style and solid recent form sees him maintain his position while others fade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady early but one of the prominent horses makes a decisive move approaching two out
scenarios.body: This catches the hold-up horses napping before they can organize their challenges effectively. Cosmic Soul's excellent recent winning sequence makes him the likely candidate to time such a move perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Achnamara sets pedestrian fractions and the prominent horses fail to apply any pressure whatsoever
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery decided by which hold-up horse gets the clearest run in a bunch finish sprint. Any of the back-markers could emerge but Knacker Trapper's recent third gives him slight edge.

watchPoints.text: Achnamara must be monitored early - if he gets an uncontested lead the hold-up horses face an impossible task
Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul's early positioning will determine whether this becomes a tactical affair or genuine test
Top Flight Century needs others to ensure a strong pace given his reliance on a finishing kick from off the pace
Laddie Cooper Mia's improvement curve makes her dangerous if getting a clear run in the straight
The going report will be crucial for several runners given the mixed surface preferences in recent form
